up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4017441. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (from the compound_structures table). Order the results by the molecule's ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    md.max_phase,
    md.molecule_type,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4017441'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
